text:
Gabe (People Ops): Quick poll  Lena's birthday is Thursday 2026-11-12. Do we do a 5-min coffee & card at 10:30 or a surprise 10-minute virtual karaoke drop-in at 4pm? low-key preferred. react with :coffee: or :microphone: please :tada:
Lena: Imma be honest  coffee is my vibe. but karaoke could be hilarious. no pressure either way!
Ravi: Coffee + card. also can we get oat milk? :coffee:
Mina: Karaoke would be mildly terrifying but in a good way :joy: I'm remote tho. can remote folks join the surprise?
Theo: If karaoke, let's keep it 2 songs max and no pressure to sing. sign me up as backup hype person.
Sam: Coffee morning sounds chill. I can pick up a pastry box (vegan option) if we go that route.
hr-bot: Reminder: no loud activities after 4pm in open seating due to nearby client calls. Also include allergen labels on shared food.
Nia: Remote  I vote coffee and will send $6 to the pool. can someone post link?
Gabe (People Ops): Tally so far: coffee 4, karaoke 2 (one ambivalent). Proposal: coffee & card at 10:25-10:40 (oat milk + vegan pastry) and an optional 2-min remote cameo at 10:33 for remote folks. Karaoke off the table per hr-bot noise note. Suggested contribution $6. I'll post pool and calendar invite.
Lena: Love it  coffee and a quick camera wave is perfect. thanks everyone! :heart:
Ravi: I'll bring oat milk and disposable cups.
Sam: Ordering pastries now. ETA 10:10.
Mina: Sent $6 (https://pay.example/giftpool/lena).
Gabe (People Ops): Calendar invite "Lena - quick coffee & hi" 10:25-10:40 created. Card on the bench. If you're remote, join the 2-min cameo at 10:33. Thanks team :sparkles:
